questions.q: What does a free-body diagram show?
o: Forces acting on one selected object

questions.q: In a free-body diagram, an arrow represents what?

questions.q: What is the resultant force?
questions.e: Net force is the vector sum of forces.

What is inertia?

questions.q: Which quantity measures inertia?
If net external force is zero, a moving object continues with ___.

questions.q: When a bus brakes suddenly, passengers tend to move ___.

questions.q: When a stationary bus starts suddenly, passengers tend to lean ___.
questions.e: Their bodies tend to remain at rest.

questions.q: What changes when a nonzero net force acts on a body?

questions.q: Which expression states Newton’s second law for constant mass?

questions.q: At fixed mass, doubling net force makes acceleration ___.

questions.e: Acceleration is inversely proportional to mass.

questions.q: The acceleration produced by net force points ___.

questions.q: One newton is equal to ___.

Forces always cancel on one body
questions.e: Action-reaction forces act on different objects.

questions.q: Why do action and reaction forces not cancel on one object?

questions.q: A swimmer pushes water backward. What pushes the swimmer forward?
A gun recoils when fired mainly because of ___.

questions.q: Which is an action-reaction pair?

questions.e: Third-law forces act on two different bodies.

questions.q: Why can a rocket accelerate in space?

questions.q: What is mass?

questions.q: What is gravitational field strength?
What is the SI unit of gravitational field strength?

questions.q: Near Earth, g is approximately ___.

questions.q: Which instrument directly measures force or weight?

questions.q: What is impulse?

Impulse is equal to ___.
Why does moving the hands backward while catching a ball reduce force?

questions.q: Net force equals the rate of change of ___.
Momentum is conserved in a system when ___.
questions.e: An isolated system has constant total momentum.

questions.q: In a collision with negligible external force, total momentum ___.

questions.q: A stationary rifle fires a bullet forward. The rifle moves ___.
questions.e: Opposite momenta keep total momentum unchanged.

questions.q: Which object has greater momentum at the same speed?

questions.q: A free-body diagram should include ___.

questions.q: A force meter is calibrated in ___.

questions.q: Which fundamental force is the weakest at the particle scale?
